diagnosis.root_cause: The q8192 gated RMSNorm used short-decode reduction geometry. Original prefill uses sixteen lanes/eight adjacent values; short decode uses thirty-two lanes/four values. The short layout exactly reproduces the failing native BF16 endpoint; the prefill layout matches all 872448 original BF16 endpoints across 71 rows in layers 0, 1 and 2.
